subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Cam Timing in Engines: Valve Events
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cam Timing in Engines: Valve Events.

hook.text: An engine valve must open and close at exact moments or the engine fails.

buildup.text: The camshaft's profile sets when each valve opens, holds, and closes.

discovery.text: Overlap — both valves open briefly — helps flush exhaust with fresh air.

twist.text: Variable valve timing changes the cam phasing with engine speed for more power.

climax.text: Honda's VTEC switches cam profiles at high RPM for a burst of extra power.

punchline.text: A cam's shape decides if the engine purrs or roars.

quiz.question: What is valve overlap in an engine?
options: When intake and exhaust valves are both open briefly to help scavenge gases
When two cylinders fire at the same time
When the camshaft and crankshaft rotate at the same speed
